request_summary: Stop `npm test` from hard-failing on machines without bash by routing the three hook suites through a small runner that detects bash, skips locally with a loud banner, and refuses to skip under CI.
rationale: C2: bounded one-way door: boundary:package.json — reduced-pipeline floor for ≤3 files in one real package (3 edit-target files / 0 package(s) (root pseudo-package excluded, Q1 2026-08-21) / 1 write-scope clusters / co-change unassessed / shape=brownfield)
entry_point: The exact-file test command (and `npm run the exact-file test command:hooks`) on a Windows contributor machine without bash
done_oracle: The exact-file test command and still succeeds; with bash present it runs all three and fails on any failure; when CI is set and bash is missing it exits 1 instead of skipping.

seam_claims.note: The template line that hard-codes the three bash invocations; it becomes a call to the new runner, and package.json is regenerated from it.
The generated twin that must match the template after regeneration.

no_single_gate_reason: The script is itself the gate; its whole purpose is deciding whether the bash-dependent hook suites can run. It is verified by executing it in this environment, where bash is absent and the skip path is what the contributor sees.
